conflicts.description: W1-W3 run in parallel; W0 launch requirements could diverge from W1's launcher.
conflicts.resolution: W0 changes no code. §7 lists the required layers; W1 implements the same flags. Superseded in part by entry 4 (all layers mandatory).

conflicts.description: Who posts the red-team record in active mode (deferred to this PR). Merged reducer.ts/broker.ts require an independent assigned reviewer.
conflicts.resolution: Follow the code: one independent assigned reviewer (AI Job via its Broker, or a human by hand). The implementer's App never posts it.

conflicts.description: T23/T24 and patrols judge and notify today; active needs one judge/notifier per PR.
conflicts.resolution: For dispatcher targets, only the dispatcher judges and notifies; patrols skip them; T23 keeps CI-policy protection. No paused PR38 code is used.

conflicts.description: RT1 (5977292218): isolation layers, Read scope, keychain, red-team timing, notice, auto-fix, decision scope.
conflicts.resolution: All §7 layers mandatory with documented flags and doctor probes; missing = disabled. Seatbelt bounds in-process Read. Keychain per owner decision. Timing recorded as an owner-approved reinterpretation. Auto-fix disabled. Decisions split from design proposals.

conflicts.description: RT2 (5977366093): dispatch-notice forgeable; decision evidence missing. Receipt 5977365862: O2-token, Codex, R008, R009.
conflicts.resolution: Notice is display-only. Receipts linked from §8. §7: setup-token via supervisor, no keychain; Codex with its own sandbox. Superseded in part by entry 5.

conflicts.description: RT3 (5977423642): receipt forgeable as well. Receipt 5977430810 (active-merge).
conflicts.resolution: Root cause: every identity is shared. AIs never merge active PRs; the owner merges in the UI; receipts and notices carry no authority. Residual risk recorded in design §7.

conflicts.description: Codex review 5404811070: R001 merge authority lost at rollback; R002 AI vs human evidence; R003 Codex reads; R004 nesting. Receipts 5977523656, 5977629581.
conflicts.resolution: No earlier RT fix reverted. Merge authority separated from launch mode (see entries 7-8). AI v1 body vs human stored binding; unprovable = hold. Codex auto-launch deferred. Nesting is version/profile dependent. Start-small scope in the switch procedure.

conflicts.description: RT5 (5977666664): setting location and per-environment copies. Receipt 5977666899.
conflicts.resolution: One source: repository variable OWNER_MERGE_ONLY; format PR numbers or `none`; unreadable = no merge; condition recorded as an owner decision.

conflicts.description: RT6 (5977715032): doc-gif read conflicts with the App rule; owner head check dropped. Receipt 5977715281.
conflicts.resolution: Read with the App merge-check purpose (#55). Owner UI head check restored. Residual risk: doc-gif can rewrite the variable. Owner review 5404975423: one home per concept, links elsewhere.
